Harmonization.Status: housing/property candidate; Official 2018 HA&I questionnaire asks what percentage of a specific house's property rights belongs to each listed family-member slot. This is a continuous percent response, not a categorical value label. Fields repeat by house/person and follow roster-dependent routes; preserve slot identity and denominators, do not sum across incompatible or missing slots, and do not infer respondent-level ownership without a prespecified derivation. The questionnaire instructs interviewers to enter 100% for the 'Other' case when the house is unrelated to the respondent/spouse or listed relatives/friends. Confirm special codes and route eligibility in the authorized release before analysis.

Harmonization.Status: housing/property candidate; Official 2018 HA&I questionnaire asks what percentage of a specific house's property rights belongs to each listed family-member slot. This is a continuous percent response, not a categorical value label. Fields repeat by house/person and follow roster-dependent routes; preserve slot identity and denominators, do not sum across incompatible or missing slots, and do not infer respondent-level ownership without a prespecified derivation. The questionnaire instructs interviewers to enter 100% for the 'Other' case when the house is unrelated to the respondent/spouse or listed relatives/friends. Confirm special codes and route eligibility in the authorized release before analysis.

Variable.Name: ha000_w4_4_2__3_
Data.File.Name: Housing
Use.Constraints: CHARLS applicant data; access and publication governed by official agreement
Harmonization.Status: housing/property candidate; Official 2018 HA&I questionnaire asks what percentage of a specific house's property rights belongs to each listed family-member slot. This is a continuous percent response, not a categorical value label. Fields repeat by house/person and follow roster-dependent routes; preserve slot identity and denominators, do not sum across incompatible or missing slots, and do not infer respondent-level ownership without a prespecified derivation. The questionnaire instructs interviewers to enter 100% for the 'Other' case when the house is unrelated to the respondent/spouse or listed relatives/friends. Confirm special codes and route eligibility in the authorized release before analysis.

Use.Constraints: CHARLS applicant data; access and publication governed by official agreement
Harmonization.Status: housing/property candidate; Official 2018 HA&I questionnaire asks what percentage of a specific house's property rights belongs to each listed family-member slot. This is a continuous percent response, not a categorical value label. Fields repeat by house/person and follow roster-dependent routes; preserve slot identity and denominators, do not sum across incompatible or missing slots, and do not infer respondent-level ownership without a prespecified derivation. The questionnaire instructs interviewers to enter 100% for the 'Other' case when the house is unrelated to the respondent/spouse or listed relatives/friends. Confirm special codes and route eligibility in the authorized release before analysis.

DA061_W3 (2015) asks status at the last interview, while DA061_W4 (2018) asks current status; preserve the wave-specific reference time and route, and do not model composite and component indicators as independent exposures.
